data.gender_notes: Haazim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haazim is a name derived from the Arabic root h-a-z, which means 'to lead', 'to guide', or 'to go before'. In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to those seen as leaders or guides in their communities or fields. The name Haazim carries the meaning “Guide, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haazim usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Haazim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haazim total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
